The customer required a full migration of their on-premises data and
• Jira management
analytics platform to a scalable cloud environment. The objective was
• Machine learning fundamentals
to significantly enhance system performance, processing speed, and
delivery capacity while modernizing the existing data ecosystem.
Solution
We designed and developed a scalable, cloud-native data and
analytics platform on Microsoft Azure. The solution included building
reusable PySpark-based data processing frameworks and executing
the end-to-end migration of workflows from the on-premises Hive
environment to Azure services. Leveraged Azure Data Lake Storage
(ADLS Gen2) for scalable storage, Azure Databricks for distributed
processing, and Azure Data Factory for orchestrating ingestion and
transformation pipelines.
